title: Resume
description: What a node that connects again says of the connection it lost (since 1.5): it lets the server tell a server that was down from a node that only lost the network.

serverStartedAt.description: The welcome.serverStartedAt of the connection that was lost: a server that started since then was down, whatever the reason.

lostAt.description: When the node lost the connection (ISO 8601).

closeCode.description: The close code the node got (1001: the server said it was going down; 1006: the connection broke); null when it got none.
